snippet.title: Tapestry - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Support us on Kickstarter! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/beeforge/tapestry-0

Tapestry is an asymmetrical turn-based multiplayer war game, where 4 mighty factions fight for control over the land. Lock in your commands in advance and weave your actions into legend!
